title: Twelve-bar blues — the realistic navigation instrument
description: A playable 12-bar blues in E minor (one sharp): the guitar carries two REAL voices — an E-minor-pentatonic melody over an alternating root–fifth bass in quarters — and a bass guitar walks the roots underneath in bass clef. The companion to the synthetic navigation-playground (which keeps the deliberately unmusical presence-rule bars): this one is for FEEL — voice jumps against non-aligned onsets, snap-to-ink melody walking, chord landing on the turnaround double-stop, section jumps Head/Turnaround. Built for the selection-ladder per-level hands-on reviews (roadmap/inprogress/selection-ladder.md).
